hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "GitHub Projects Workflow: Before implementation — Issue + board item required. Set Status In Progress when work starts. Use gh CLI (primary). Absolute blob URLs only after push+verify. Update Issue body checklist each phase."}}'

hooks.prompt:
Before stopping, verify:
1. Issue + project board item exist for non-trivial work.
2. Board Status matches reality (In Progress / Blocked / In review / Done).
3. Progress documented: body checklist updated; any .md linked via absolute URL after push+verify.
4. If project policy requires skeptic and task is complete — skeptic done.
If any required item is NO, finish it before stopping. Trivial Q&A (1-3 sentences, no code) is exempt.
